facts.fact: Togo's Instance de Protection des Données à Caractère Personnel (IPDCP), headed by its president Colonel Béléi Bédiani, put a team into the media regulator HARC's monitoring service on 19 October 2026, as the IPDCP itself reported.
facts.system: Instance de Protection des Données à Caractère Personnel (IPDCP)

facts.fact: The IPDCP says its work with the media regulator HARC aims to root compliance with the requirements of Togo's law on the protection of personal data, with measures the law provides where needed.
facts.system: loi relative à la protection des données à caractère personnel

facts.fact: The IPDCP, headed by president Colonel Béléi Bédiani, put a team into HARC's monitoring service on 19 October 2026 under a partnership convention signed on 10 December 2025.
facts.system: Instance de Protection des Données à Caractère Personnel (IPDCP)

facts.fact: The IPDCP refers to compliance with the requirements of Togo's law on the protection of personal data as a standing obligation of media organisations.

facts.fact: The IPDCP team will watch media practice on personal data and answer each case with support, awareness-raising or the measures the law provides, the IPDCP says.
